name: TIMECOM
recent: 近期公告主要是雇员公积金局（EPF）和退休基金局（KWAP）的股东权益变动申报，未见重大企业活动。新闻方面，CIMB Securities 将公司评级上调至「Buy」，RAM 维持其 10 亿令吉 Sukuk 的 AA1 评级。最新财报显示营收和净利均同比增长。
notable: CIMB Securities 将 TIME dotCom 评级上调至「Buy」。
RAM 维持 TIME dotCom 10 亿令吉 Sukuk 的 AA1 评级，展望稳定。
公司参与 2026 年 Top Tech Innovation Awards 合作。
risks: EPF 和 KWAP 在多个交易日申报股东权益变动，需留意后续持股变化。
earnings: 截至 2026 年 6 月 30 日季度，营收为 4.7778 亿令吉，环比增长 5.2%，同比增长 7.2%；净利为 1.3463 亿令吉，环比增长 13.0%，同比增长 28.7%；净利率为 28.2%，高于上一季度的 26.2%。

recent_en: Recent announcements mainly comprise changes in substantial shareholder interests by EPF and KWAP, with no major corporate activities. The latest financial results show both revenue and net profit grew year-on-year.
notable_en: RAM affirmed TIME dotCom's RM1 billion Sukuk rating at AA1 with stable outlook.
The company partnered with the Top Tech Innovation Awards 2026.
risks_en: EPF and KWAP reported changes in shareholder interests over multiple trading days; subsequent shareholding changes should be monitored.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was RM477.78 million, up 5.2% QoQ and 7.2% YoY; net profit was RM134.63 million, up 13.0% QoQ and 28.7% YoY; net margin was 28.2%, higher than 26.2% in the previous quarter.
